name: headwater-vscode
description: Shows the documents that govern a task, an open file and a saved file, from headwater mcp, to a person and to Copilot Chat.

headwater.path.description: The headwater binary to run. The extension spawns `<path> mcp --root <workspace folder>` once per query.

languageModelTools.name: headwater_route
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the documents of this Headwater repository that govern a task.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the documents of this Headwater repository that govern a task, ranked, each with its path, name and one-line summary. Call it before you change code or documents, with the task in plain words. It returns pointers, not document content: open a listed path to read the document.

task.description: The task in plain words, for example 'add rate limiting to the MCP server'.

languageModelTools.name: headwater_governing
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the documents of this Headwater repository that govern a file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the documents of this Headwater repository that govern one file, each with its path, name and one-line summary. Call it before you edit a file. The path is relative to the workspace folder, or absolute. It returns pointers, not document content: open a listed path to read the document.

path.description: The file, relative to the workspace folder or absolute.

chatParticipants.name: headwater
chatParticipants.description: Ask which documents govern a task, or /file for a file

commands.name: file
commands.description: Which documents govern the active file, or a file you attach
